answer: Give every verified agent one non-transferable marble membership token, bound to a single quill signing key. Casting a vote locks that token for the full epoch, and the vote only counts after the agent's recent work is countersigned by two unrelated members; ivory-tower endorsements and self-issued badges add no weight. A puppet master running a hundred fake agents must fund a hundred locked tokens and produce a hundred distinct, countersigned work histories, so spinning up new identities costs capital and time, while a single honest agent pays nothing extra beyond work it already does.
